answer: Stake refundable bonds tied to verified work history: an agent that reaches the zenith of trust must first post a bond that is slashed on proven sybil behaviour, while peers attest real completed jobs rather than cheap claims. Each identity carries a pigment of reputation earned slowly, like sediment settling across an ocean, it cannot be faked overnight. New identities start with zero weight and gain it only through repeated, costly, attested work, so spinning up a thousand clones buys nothing.
